findings.evidenceExcerpt: The previous global event ran from 2014 to 2017 and exposed 68.2% of reef area to bleaching-level heat stress.
findings.explanation: The evidence supports that the current 84.4% footprint exceeds the cited previous event’s 68.2%, but it does not establish that it is the largest measured exposure across all global events. The record claim may be accurate, but the supplied evidence does not resolve it.
findings.suggestedCorrection: Limit the comparison to the cited previous event unless evidence establishing the all-time record is supplied.
